1: Statutory leave reckoned by calendar years.
2: Leave prorated to successive holders of an office within a calendar year.
3: Unused annual leave may be accumulated and allowed in next calendar year; no more than120days taken in any calendar year.
4: Apply for leave to WarSecretary through Governor and report departure and return to Governor. Application routing and both reporting events must be retained.

These referenced earlier instruments were not supplied as complete frozen witnesses; no inference of their precise effect.
